I told Dana in our DM that the seat count for Amendment No. 1 is 185.

The number comes from her own messages in #north-team on 2025-08-20, the day after the amendment was signed. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

I couldn't see the amendment itself, because no Quarrendon contract files show up in the share for her. So I suggested she check the signed copy she sent June if the QBR deck needs to match the contract exactly.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
